title: Western blot: lysis to bands
objective: Explain how a western blot separates and detects a specific protein.

steps.title: Sort by size, then probe
steps.body: A **[[western blot]]** separates proteins by size with **[[SDS-PAGE]]** (SDS coats proteins with negative charge so they migrate by size in a gel), transfers them to a membrane, then detects one protein with a primary **[[antibody]]** and a labeled secondary. The target shows up as a band at its molecular weight.

items: Lyse cells and denature proteins in SDS
Run SDS-PAGE to separate by size
steps.explanation: Separate by size, move to membrane, then the antibody sandwich reveals the target band.

steps.prompt: What does SDS do in SDS-PAGE?
options: Coats proteins in uniform negative charge so they sort by size
Cuts every protein down into its single amino acids
Adds a fluorescent tag onto each and every protein
Amplifies the total amount of protein in the sample
steps.explanation: SDS gives a roughly constant charge-to-mass ratio, so migration depends on size, not native charge or shape.

variants.setup: SDS coats every protein with negative charge.
variants.prompt: What then determines how far a protein runs?
variants.reveal: With charge normalized, smaller proteins run faster — separation by size.

steps.prompt: A western gives a band at an unexpected size. A reasonable first check is…
options: Consider cross-reactivity or a modified form, and validate the antibody
Report it as your target, since the vendor says the antibody is specific
Raise the antibody concentration until the expected band shows up
Re-run the same gel with a much longer exposure to find the right band
steps.explanation: Unexpected bands often mean cross-reactivity or a modified/processed form. Antibody validation (C7) applies here too.

variants.setup: Your antibody gives a band at the wrong molecular weight.
options: Validate the antibody; weigh cross-reactivity or modification
Trust it, since the vendor says the antibody is specific
Raise the antibody concentration to find the right band
variants.reveal: Wrong-size bands demand validation, not acceptance.

reviewNotes: Western workflow; links antibody validation from C7.
